skill.name: material-component-doc
skill.description: Create FlowGram material component documentation with MDX templates, Story examples, API tables, source walkthroughs, and translation guidance.
skill.summary: Guides FlowGram component documentation from source review to bilingual MDX pages and Story examples.
skill.author: bytedance

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown code fences, inline paths, Mermaid diagrams, and fixed React examples. One confirmed medium risk remains: the template recommends running an npm CLI with @latest, which can execute changing remote package code.

remediation.issue: Unpinned remote CLI execution in the documentation template.
remediation.suggestion: Pin @flowgram.ai/cli to a reviewed version and describe expected command effects before users run it.

content.value_statement: FlowGram material docs need consistent Story examples, API tables, and source explanations. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a repeatable workflow for MDX documentation.
actual_capabilities: Guides source discovery for FlowGram material components.
Defines where Chinese and English MDX documentation should be created.
Provides Story component conventions for lazy loading and wrapper usage.
Supplies a reusable material documentation template.
Includes translation rules for bilingual documentation.
Lists quality checks for screenshots, links, Mermaid diagrams, and CLI paths.
limitations: Targets FlowGram material component documentation only.
Requires access to the FlowGram repository structure.
Does not validate generated MDX at runtime by itself.
Screenshots and translation should still be reviewed by users.

use_cases.title: Document a New Component
use_cases.description: Create a complete MDX page with examples, props, screenshots, and source notes for a new material component.

use_cases.title: Standardize Story Examples
use_cases.description: Create Story components that follow FlowGram naming, lazy loading, and form wrapper conventions.

use_cases.title: Prepare English Documentation
use_cases.description: Translate approved Chinese documentation while preserving code, links, formatting, and FlowGram terminology.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Component Doc
prompt_templates.scenario: Begin with a known component name.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create documentation for the FlowGram material component named [component]. First inspect the source files and list what information you need from me.

prompt_templates.title: Create Story Examples
prompt_templates.scenario: Build examples before writing the MDX page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create Story examples for [component] using the project conventions. Include basic usage and one advanced case based on the component props.

prompt_templates.title: Draft the Full MDX Page
prompt_templates.scenario: Write a complete Chinese documentation page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the material documentation template to draft the Chinese MDX page for [component]. Include demos, API tables, source notes, and dependency links.

prompt_templates.title: Review and Translate
prompt_templates.scenario: Finalize approved documentation for English readers.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the approved Chinese MDX for [component], identify issues, then translate it to English while preserving code, paths, and Markdown structure.

output_examples.input: A developer asks for documentation for a new variable selector component.
output: A source analysis summary with props, dependencies, and required examples.
A Story plan with basic and schema-filtered demonstrations.
A documentation outline covering usage, API reference, source walkthrough, and links.

output_examples.input: A writer asks to translate an approved Chinese material document.
output: An English document that keeps code blocks, command names, and internal paths unchanged.
A checklist of links, terms, diagrams, and screenshots that need final review.

best_practices: Confirm the component source path before drafting documentation.
Ask users for real usage examples before writing advanced sections.
Review generated Story components and MDX links in the docs site.
anti_patterns: Do not translate code blocks, import paths, command names, or component names.
Do not invent props that are missing from the source code.
Do not publish English documentation before the Chinese version is approved.

faq.question: What repository structure does this skill expect?
faq.answer: It expects FlowGram docs, material source, Story components, and public assets to use the paths listed in SKILL.md.

faq.question: Can it create Story components?
faq.answer: Yes. It provides naming rules, lazy import examples, wrapper usage, and Story export patterns.

faq.question: Does it replace manual review?
faq.answer: No. Users should still verify examples, props, screenshots, links, and translations before publishing.

faq.question: Does it support English and Chinese docs?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides Chinese documentation first, then translates approved content to English.

faq.question: Can it document non-FlowGram components?
faq.answer: Not directly. The paths, templates, and examples are specific to FlowGram material components.

faq.question: What should users provide before drafting?
faq.answer: Users should provide the component name, intended use cases, example scenarios, and screenshot requirements.
